reasoning_content:
QGIS server itself is healthy (internal GetCapabilities 200). The proxy through nginx/caddy requires auth. The guide says QGIS Server: https://qgis.localhost/ows/?MAP=/projects/<project>.qgs. It returns 401 without auth which is expected (auth proxy). With auth it returns 500 because test-project.qgz is a 16-byte placeholder. That's a user-provided placeholder, not an installation defect per the guide.

Now let me verify the app.localhost frontend actually connects to the API. The frontend was built with API_URL internal. Let me check that the frontend can reach the backend. Actually the login flow. Let's check the frontend's server-side rendering requests. But we got the HTML rendered. Good.

Let me verify the documented entry points response. Most returned proper codes. Let me test the webdav with auth and qgis with auth.

Let me also confirm admin login works with a CSRF-less flow? Just check admin page 200 is enough.

Let me check the frontend can do a login via API — the PUBLIC_API_URL is https://api.localhost/api/v1/. From browser perspective. That's client side.

Let me verify remaining endpoints and the WMS proxy (backend-wms). Also check tileserver serves an actual tile.

Let me check that germany.mbtiles only covers Monaco (summary says tiles cover only Monaco). Not essential.

Let me test the tileserver actual tile and style.

Also check that the app's health is fine. Let's do a final round.

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments:
{"command": "cd /tmp
TOKEN=$(curl -sk --resolve api.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"username":"admin","password":"AdminLocalPassw0rd!"}' https://api.localhost/api/v1/auth/login/ | sed -n 's/.*"access":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')
echo "=== webdav auth ==="; curl -sk --resolve files.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X PROPFIND -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" https://files.localhost/
echo "=== qgis auth+MAP ==="; curl -sk --resolve qgis.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://qgis.localhost/ows/?SERVICE=WMS&REQUEST=GetCapabilities&MAP=/projects/test-project.qgz" -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" | head -c 400
echo; echo "=== qgis auth no MAP ==="; curl -sk --resolve qgis.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://qgis.localhost/ows/?SERVICE=WMS&REQUEST=GetCapabilities" -w "\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n" | head -c 300
echo; echo "=== tiles json ==="; curl -sk --resolve tiles.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 https://tiles.localhost/data/ -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n"", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Test webdav and qgis with auth, tiles data"}

summary: Test webdav and qgis with auth, tiles data
